description.p: Voicenux is a voice changer and soundboard for Linux. It adds a “Voicenux Microphone” that Discord, OBS, games and every other app can use.

ul.li: 69 voices: baby, elderly, robot, demon, underwater, radio, auto-tune and many more
Background sounds like rain, bubbles, a crowd or a campfire
A soundboard with your own sounds and a starter pack
Voicelab: build your own voices from 25 effects
Hear yourself, noise suppression, global shortcuts and a tray icon

description.p: Voicenux ist ein Stimmverzerrer und Soundboard für Linux. Es fügt ein „Voicenux Microphone“ hinzu, das Discord, OBS, Spiele und jede andere App nutzen können.
Voicenux es un cambiador de voz y soundboard para Linux. Añade un «Micrófono Voicenux» que Discord, OBS, los juegos y cualquier otra app pueden usar.
Voicenux est un modificateur de voix et une soundboard pour Linux. Il ajoute un « Micro Voicenux » que Discord, OBS, les jeux et toutes les autres apps peuvent utiliser.
O Voicenux é um modificador de voz e soundboard para Linux. Ele adiciona um “Microfone Voicenux” que o Discord, o OBS, os jogos e qualquer outro app podem usar.
Voicenux è un modificatore vocale e una soundboard per Linux. Aggiunge un “Microfono Voicenux” che Discord, OBS, i giochi e ogni altra app possono usare.
Voicenux to zmieniacz głosu i soundboard dla Linuksa. Dodaje „Mikrofon Voicenux”, którego mogą używać Discord, OBS, gry i każda inna aplikacja.
Voicenux это модулятор голоса и саундборд для Linux. Он добавляет «Микрофон Voicenux», который могут использовать Discord, OBS, игры и любые другие приложения.
Voicenux, Linux için bir ses değiştirici ve soundboard. Discord, OBS, oyunlar ve diğer tüm uygulamaların kullanabileceği bir “Voicenux Mikrofonu” ekler.

screenshot.caption: Build your own voices in Voicelab

description.p: Voicenux in seven more languages, search sounds by voice, speech recognition for apps like the Stream Deck plugin, and switch sounds.
Voicenux asks before another app may control it, a note when Discord may filter out your sounds, the mouse wheel on sliders, a random favorite and advanced settings.
AI voices on AMD graphics cards, a question about starting with the computer on the welcome screen, and new API actions for sounds.
